title: Internal: deciding a demurrage dispute and booking its credit
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, the desk decides a lodged dispute against an invoice line of a per-container record and, where the customer is owed a reduction, books a dispute credit. This entry covers when a dispute credit may be booked and the internal tool that books it.

## When it applies

A dispute credit is booked only against a dispute the billed party has lodged on the invoice line and that is still submitted, and the credit references both that dispute and the disputed line.

> A dispute credit requires a dispute the billed party has lodged on the invoice row and that is still submitted.

Put as a handling condition: before a dispute credit is handled, a dispute lodged by the billed party must already stand on that line with the status submitted; where there is none, no dispute credit is booked.

## Business effect of the booking

- One dispute credit entry dated today is written on the free-time record, pointing at the disputed invoice line and at the dispute most recently lodged against that line.
- The balance the billed party owes on the record is lowered by the amount credited.
- The decision is recorded on that dispute, and the customer sees the dispute decided and the credit against the invoice line.
- The dispute is identified by the invoice line alone: it is the one with the latest lodging time among the disputes filed against the line, whatever outcome it currently carries, and the outcome passed replaces that outcome.

## How it is invoked

The tool is **book_dispute_credit_515e844f**, an internal tool the agent must first unlock (through unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then call (through call_agent_discoverable_tool).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format or values |
|---|---|---|
| dnd_id | Reference number of the free-time record carrying the disputed invoice line, as returned by the free-time record lookup | identifier |
| invoice_event_id | Invoice reference of the disputed invoice line, as returned by the account entry lookup | identifier |
| outcome | Decision recorded on the dispute | exactly one of: upheld (the credit equals the whole amount disputed), partially_upheld (a credit is given but it is smaller than the amount disputed), denied (the dispute fails and no credit would be due), submitted (the dispute stays undecided), withdrawn (the customer took the dispute back) |
| amount_usd | Amount credited | USD, a positive figure given to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful booking answers "Dispute (dispute reference) decided (outcome); credit (credit entry reference) of USD (amount) booked against invoice line (invoice reference) on record (record reference); balance due now USD (balance)." The dispute reference is the identifier of the latest dispute lodged against the line, or the word none when the line carries no dispute; the balance is the record's outstanding amount in USD to 2 decimal places after the credit. An answer starting with "Error:" means no record exists under that reference and nothing was booked.
